If Soaring Slam is cast while channeling Powerball}}, enemies within the center of the impact are also airborne for 0.75 seconds and take collision damage. lines.label: Change
lines.note: Soaring Slam's minimum cast range is 600 units and is also equal to 130% of his average movement speed over the past 1 second.

lines.label: Change
